How we work

From first call to production, in four steps.

  1. 01 — Discover

    Scope & strategy

    We map your requirements, constraints and success criteria, so there are no surprises three months in.

  2. 02 — Design

    Architecture & plan

    The architecture, data model and main user flows are agreed before production code is written.

  3. 03 — Build

    Iterative delivery

    Short cycles with regular demos and automated tests, so you see working software, not status updates.

  4. 04 — Deploy

    Launch & support

    We handle production deployment and monitoring, and stay on for support after launch.

Why your Spring Boot @Scheduled job runs twice (and what actually stops it)

Add a second instance and every @Scheduled job runs twice. We counted the duplicates across six setups: ShedLock fixes it, but only with two settings that are easy to get wrong.

The case of the vanishing JobRunr runs

Going, going, gone: closing Firebase auctions on time

Bids pile up in the last seconds, and a once-a-minute sweep closes auctions late. The pattern we recommend: the deadline in the bid transaction, one Cloud Task per auction and an idempotent close.
